version.changelog: 重写文件blob存储为base64格式，彻底解决IndexedDB结构化克隆导致二进制文件下载失败

llm.summary: This local note-board skill mostly matches its stated purpose, but uploaded documents may remain in browser storage after deletion controls suggest they are gone.

dimensions.detail: Browser localStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard copy, file upload, and downloads are proportionate to the stated local note/document workflow, with no network exfiltration found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static SKILL.md plus a single HTML asset and reference text; no executable installer or background service is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is somewhat broad, including generic note/clipboard tools and packaging HTML as a skill, but it does not add hidden runtime authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent local storage is disclosed, but uploaded file blobs are written to IndexedDB and the available delete/purge flows remove metadata without calling the existing fileBlobDelete function, leaving residual document data possible.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently described as a local-first single-file HTML app for collecting text, images, folders, and exporting Word documents.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with notes, pasted images, and uploaded documents being stored persistently in the browser profile. Avoid using it for sensitive documents on shared machines unless you can manually clear the site's browser storage when finished.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger wording is a routing/scoping concern, but artifact review did not find hidden capabilities or extra authority tied to it.
[SQP-2] expected: Local persistence is central to the app and is disclosed; however, uploaded-file retention is under-controlled because permanent deletion paths do not appear to remove stored blobs from IndexedDB.
